intro: Between April 13 and May 16, 2026, ZCyberNews published 16 articles covering authentication-bypass vulnerabilities, with the most frequently cited issues being CVE-2026-20127 and CVE-2026-20182, both carrying a CVSS score of 10. Other notable CVEs include CVE-2026-41940 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-33413 (CVSS 8.8), and CVE-2026-41276 (CVSS 8.1). The coverage spanned technology, software development, telecommunications, ai, and critical infrastructure sectors, with a global impact. The severity mix across articles was 7 high, 6 critical, and 3 medium.
